description: This file manages session store targets for agents, including discovery, validation, and resolution of session store paths, with functions for synchronous and asynchronous operations.

methods.name: dedupeTargetsByStorePath
methods.description: Removes duplicate session store targets based on storePath.

methods.name: shouldSkipDiscoveryError
methods.description: Determines if an error should be ignored based on its code.

methods.name: isWithinRoot
methods.description: Checks if a path is within a specified root directory.

methods.name: shouldSkipDiscoveredAgentDirName
methods.description: Decides whether to skip a directory based on its name and agent ID.

methods.name: resolveValidatedDiscoveredStorePathSync
methods.description: Synchronously validates and resolves the path to a session store JSON file.

methods.name: resolveValidatedDiscoveredStorePath
methods.description: Asynchronously validates and resolves the path to a session store JSON file.

methods.name: resolveSessionStoreDiscoveryState
methods.description: Discovers session store targets and agent roots based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: toDiscoveredSessionStoreTarget
methods.description: Converts session directory and store path into a SessionStoreTarget, with filtering.

methods.name: resolveAllAgentSessionStoreTargetsSync
methods.description: Synchronously discovers all session store targets for agents.

methods.name: resolveAllAgentSessionStoreTargets
methods.description: Asynchronously discovers all session store targets for agents.

methods.name: resolveSessionStoreTargets
methods.description: Resolves session store targets based on configuration options.
